Chinese Buddhist apocrypha
In
Buddhist studies
, particularly East Asian Buddhist studies,
post-canonical Buddhist texts
,
Buddhist apocrypha
or
Spurious Sutras and Sastras
designate texts that are not accepted as canonical by some historical Buddhist schools or communities who referred to a
canon
. The term is principally applied to texts that purport to represent Buddhist teaching translated from Indian texts, but were written in East Asia.
